stories.headline: TSMC and Samsung join ASML push to scrap the 6-inch photomask after four decades

key_facts.fact: On September 7, ahead of the SPIE BACUS conference in Monterey, ASML and TSMC formed an industry-wide initiative to move High NA EUV lithography from today's 6-inch photomasks to 12-inch masks.
key_facts.excerpt: On September 7, in advance of the SPIE Bacus Conference, ASML and TSMC formed a collaborative industry initiative to drive the transition to 12-inch photomasks, maximizing the value of High NA EUV lithography.

key_facts.fact: The initiative targets a 12-inch mask pilot line by 2031 and full lithography system readiness for advanced-node production by 2033.
key_facts.excerpt: The initiative targets establishing a 12-inch mask pilot line by 2031, supporting full lithography system readiness for advanced node production by 2033.

key_facts.fact: TSMC said it intends to use ASML's High NA technology in high-volume manufacturing for advanced nodes starting in 2030 — its first firm commitment to the tool.
key_facts.excerpt: TSMC intends to use ASML's High NA technology in high-volume manufacturing for advanced nodes starting in 2030.

key_facts.fact: Samsung said on September 8 it will join the 12-inch photomask initiative and plans to be the first company to put High NA EUV into high-volume DRAM manufacturing, by 2028.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung also plans to introduce ASML's High NA extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography into future DRAM high-volume manufacturing for the first time in the industry by 2028

key_facts.fact: Intel Foundry said it has processed more than one million 300mm wafers on High NA EUV scanners, and has championed the large-mask format for more than three years.
key_facts.excerpt: With more than one million wafers processed to date, Intel Foundry and ASML are helping customers put High NA EUV to work today while preparing for future scale

key_facts.fact: The mask change matters because High NA EUV's anamorphic optics limit a 6-inch mask to a 26x16.5mm half-field, forcing large chips to be exposed twice and 'stitched'; a 6x12-inch mask restores the full 26x33mm field in one shot.
key_facts.excerpt: a 6x6 mask can provide only approximately 26x16.5 mm on the wafer... To avoid using stitching, the industry — led by Intel — plans to shift to larger 6x12 masks, which will enable a 26x33 mm full field in one exposure.

stories.headline: Qualcomm wins AWS custom-silicon deal with warrants tied to up to $60B of purchases

key_facts.fact: Qualcomm announced on September 8 a multi-generational collaboration with Amazon Web Services to co-develop customized silicon for AI data center infrastructure, focused on inference workloads.
key_facts.excerpt: Qualcomm announced a partnership with Amazon Web Services on Tuesday to develop custom chips for AI data center infrastructure... The two companies will work together across multiple generations of customized silicon, with a focus on inference workloads.

key_facts.fact: Qualcomm shares jumped on the news, rising as much as 10% in Tuesday trading.
key_facts.excerpt: sending Qualcomm stock up 10%

key_facts.fact: Qualcomm issued Amazon an equity warrant for up to 25 million shares at an exercise price of $161.26, worth roughly $4 billion, vesting in stages as Amazon buys hardware.
key_facts.excerpt: Qualcomm issued Amazon an equity warrant to buy an about $4 billion stake, giving it the right to buy up to 25 million shares of common stock at an exercise price of $161.26 per share over the next decade.

key_facts.fact: Full vesting requires Amazon to spend up to $60 billion on Qualcomm server chips, networking gear and manufacturing services through 2036; 3.75 million shares unlocked immediately on initial purchase commitments.
key_facts.excerpt: While an initial 3.75 million shares unlocked immediately based on Amazon's starting purchase commitments, unlocking the full haul requires Amazon to spend up to $60 billion on Qualcomm server chips, networking gear, and manufacturing services through 2036.

key_facts.fact: The two companies also plan 1.6 terabit-per-second optical connectivity built on Qualcomm's SerDes and optical DSP technology for AWS data centers.
key_facts.excerpt: The two companies plan to build 1.6 terabit-per-second (1.6T) optical connectivity solutions leveraging Qualcomm's high-speed SerDes and optical digital signal processor (DSP) technologies

key_facts.fact: AWS is Qualcomm's second named hyperscaler after Meta, which committed to deploy the Dragonfly C1000 data center CPU in production from 2028; Qualcomm targets $5B of data center revenue in fiscal 2027 and $15B in fiscal 2029.
key_facts.excerpt: Qualcomm is targeting $5 billion in data-center revenue in fiscal 2027 and $15 billion in fiscal 2029... this is Qualcomm's second major hyperscaler win, following Meta's commitment to use the Dragonfly C1000 starting in 2028 production

stories.headline: Celero raises $275M at over $3B to build 2nm optical chips linking AI data centers

key_facts.fact: Celero Communications announced a $275 million Series C on September 8, valuing the networking-chip startup at over $3 billion and bringing total capital raised to $415 million.
key_facts.excerpt: Celero Communications, a leader in advanced coherent DSP technology for AI infrastructure, today announced a $275 million Series C funding round, bringing its total capital raised to $415 million and valuing the company at over $3 billion.

key_facts.fact: The round was led by Atreides Management, Valor Equity Partners and Alphabet's growth fund CapitalG.
key_facts.excerpt: It was led by Atreides Management, Valor Equity Partners and Alphabet's (GOOGL) venture capital arm CapitalG.

key_facts.fact: Celero also said it validated what it calls the industry's first 2nm coherent DSP silicon, supporting optical links from 1.6T to 3.2T.
key_facts.excerpt: Celero has also validated the industry's first 2nm coherent DSP silicon, establishing a scalable foundation for next-generation AI optical interconnects from 1.6T to 3.2T.

key_facts.fact: Its coherent digital signal processors convert electrical signals into light pulses so AI accelerator clusters can be linked across and between data centers, as traditional PAM4 optical architectures hit their limits.
key_facts.excerpt: As AI infrastructure scales, traditional PAM4 optical architectures are reaching their limits, and coherent connectivity is emerging as the critical foundation for scalable, efficient data transfer in hyperscale AI clusters and cloud data centers

key_facts.fact: The valuation is a sharp markup: the Irvine, California company raised a $100 million Series B led by CapitalG only in November 2025, on total funding of $140 million.
key_facts.excerpt: This includes a recent $100 million Series B investment led by CapitalG (Alphabet's independent growth fund) and earlier Series A and seed rounds totaling $40 million led by Sutter Hill Ventures

key_facts.fact: Celero was founded in 2024 by engineers from Marvell, Inphi, Broadcom and ClariPhy, and is headquartered in Irvine, California with design centers in Canada and Argentina.
key_facts.excerpt: Founded in 2024 by industry leaders from Marvell, Inphi, Broadcom, and ClariPhy... The company is headquartered in Irvine, California, with design centers in Canada and Argentina.

stories.headline: US Energy Department closes $1.9B loan to restart Iowa nuclear plant that will power Google

key_facts.fact: NextEra Energy said it finalised a loan agreement with the US Department of Energy for up to $1.9 billion to support the restart of the Duane Arnold nuclear power station in Iowa.
key_facts.excerpt: US utility NextEra Energy has finalised a loan agreement with the US Department of Energy (DOE) for up to $1.9bn (€1.63bn) to support the restart of the Duane Arnold nuclear power station in Iowa, the company said.

key_facts.fact: The loan was made through the DOE's Office of Energy Dominance Financing, which announced financial close on Tuesday, September 8.
key_facts.excerpt: The U.S. Department of Energy's (DOE) Office of Energy Dominance Financing announced Tuesday the financial close of a loan of up to $1.9 billion to NextEra Energy.

key_facts.fact: NextEra plans to restart Duane Arnold no later than the first quarter of 2029, subject to regulatory approvals; it is Iowa's only nuclear plant and has been shut since 2020.
key_facts.excerpt: The company said that it planned to restart Duane Arnold no later than the first quarter of 2029, subject to regulatory approvals.

key_facts.fact: The 615-MW boiling water reactor is anchored by a 25-year power purchase agreement signed with Google in October 2025 to supply carbon-free power for its Iowa cloud and AI data centers.
key_facts.excerpt: Google will purchase power from the 615-MW plant as a 24/7 carbon-free energy source to help power Google's growing cloud and AI infrastructure in Iowa

key_facts.fact: Central Iowa Power Cooperative buys the remaining output on matching terms; NextEra agreed to acquire the co-ops' combined 30% interest to take full ownership.
key_facts.excerpt: NextEra Energy has signed definitive agreements to acquire CIPCO and Corn Belt Power Cooperative's combined 30% interest in the plant, which will bring NextEra Energy's ownership to 100%.

stories.headline: China sets 9,800-exaflop compute target for 2030, backed by $532B infrastructure plan

key_facts.fact: China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology released a five-year plan for the information and communications sector setting a target of 9,800 exaflops of intelligent computing capacity by 2030.
key_facts.excerpt: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT), in a five-year industry plan released on Monday, set a target of 9,800 eflops of intelligent computing capacity by 2030

key_facts.fact: The plan calls for 3.8 trillion yuan (about $532 billion) in cumulative information infrastructure investment over 2026-2030.
key_facts.excerpt: called for 3.8 trillion yuan (US$532 billion) in cumulative information infrastructure investment over the 2026-2030 period

key_facts.fact: China's intelligent computing capacity reached 2,185 exaflops at the end of June, up 177% year on year, with 52 facilities each holding more than 10,000 accelerator cards.
key_facts.excerpt: China's intelligent computing capacity had reached 2,185 eflops... by the end of June, up 177 per cent from a year earlier, and the country had built 52 intelligent computing facilities each equipped with more than 10,000 accelerator cards

key_facts.fact: The plan calls for the 'orderly deployment' of clusters with 10,000 or 100,000-plus accelerator cards and for greater efforts to adapt infrastructure to home-grown chips.
key_facts.excerpt: The plan calls for the 'orderly deployment' of clusters with 10,000 cards or those using 100,000 or more cards... It also calls for greater efforts to adapt infrastructure to home-grown computing chips.

key_facts.fact: Against a 2025 baseline of 1,590 exaflops, the 2030 goal implies a roughly 6.2-fold increase; the plan also targets 1,700 exabytes of advanced storage and PUE below 1.2 for new hyperscale facilities.
key_facts.excerpt: The target table sets the 2030 goal at 9,800 eflops against the 1,590 eflops recorded for 2025, and pairs it with an advanced storage capacity target of 1,700 exabytes by 2030, up from 540 exabytes in 2025. New large and hyperscale computing facilities are expected to run at a power usage effectiveness below 1.2

key_facts.fact: MIIT also reported an overall rack utilisation rate of 71.4% across national computing facilities, and more than 70 high-capacity computing corridors built between national hub nodes in the past two years.
key_facts.excerpt: with an overall rack utilization rate of 71.4% across national computing facilities... including more than 70 high-capacity computing corridors linking national hub nodes over the past two years

stories.headline: Huawei emerges as project manager of China's domestic lithography push against ASML

key_facts.fact: The Financial Times reported that Huawei is investing across China's lithography equipment supply chain and helping domestic toolmakers place machines with leading fabs including SMIC.
key_facts.excerpt: Huawei is investing across the industry that supplies lithography equipment. It is also helping those suppliers get their machines into Chinese fabs, including SMIC.

key_facts.fact: Shanghai-based Yuliangsheng co-developed the first Chinese-made advanced deep ultraviolet machine, now being tested at SMIC and on Huawei's own production lines, with a target of 12 machines by the end of 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: SMIC... is testing Yuliangsheng's machines, including on Huawei production lines. The company plans to build 12 machines by the end of 2026.

key_facts.fact: Bernstein analyst Lin Qingyuan described Huawei's role as effectively China's DUV 'project manager', coordinating a supply chain of thousands of companies.
key_facts.excerpt: Bernstein semiconductor analyst Lin Qingyuan described Huawei's role as effectively being China's DUV 'project manager', coordinating a supply chain involving thousands of companies and prospective customers.

key_facts.fact: Huawei's venture arm Habo and a second Huawei-backed fund invested in optics maker Fujian Zhiqi Photonics — paying about $15 million for a 37% stake in 2023 — and in light-source developer Beijing RSLaser.
key_facts.excerpt: Its venture arm Habo and a second Huawei-backed fund have both invested in Fujian Zhiqi Photonics... The fund took a 37% stake for about $15m in 2023.

key_facts.fact: Yuliangsheng's machine still uses projection lenses made by Germany's Zeiss, which says it sells lithography optics only to ASML; industry insiders told the FT the lenses could be obtained on China's secondary market.
key_facts.excerpt: Yuliangsheng uses projection lenses made by Zeiss, according to two people familiar with the matter. Zeiss said it sells its lithography optics only to ASML. Industry insiders told the FT the lenses could be obtained on the secondary market in China.

key_facts.fact: SMIC pairs a 28nm Yuliangsheng tool with multi-patterning to reach 7nm chips, but still runs production on ASML machines; ASML's China sales are projected at roughly a fifth of its revenue this year.
key_facts.excerpt: SMIC pairs it with multi-patterning, a technique that runs a wafer through the machine repeatedly, to reach 7nm chips... They still run production on ASML. The Dutch company's China sales are projected at about a fifth of its revenue this year

stories.headline: Arm launches Neoverse CSS N4 'Ranger', a 128-core semi-custom platform on TSMC N3P

key_facts.fact: Arm announced Neoverse Compute Subsystems N4 on September 8, its most configurable semi-custom data center platform, alongside momentum updates for its AGI CPU.
key_facts.excerpt: Arm Neoverse Compute Subsystems N4 delivers Arm's most configurable CSS yet, enabling the fastest path from CSS to silicon

key_facts.fact: CSS N4 supports 8 to 128 Neoverse N4 cores per die at up to 3.8 GHz, with LPDDR6 memory and PCIe Gen 7 connectivity.
key_facts.excerpt: With up to 128 cores per die, CSS N4 supports LPDDR6 memory and PCIe Gen 7 connectivity

key_facts.fact: Arm claims up to 2x the performance, 1.25x the performance per watt and 1.75x the memory bandwidth of Neoverse CSS N3.
key_facts.excerpt: delivers up to 2x the performance, up to 1.25x the performance per watt and up to 1.75x memory bandwidth of Neoverse CSS N3

key_facts.fact: The platform, codenamed Ranger, is built on TSMC's N3P process and carries up to 256 MB of L3 cache per die, 128 lanes of PCIe 6/7 and CXL 4.0, with UCIe support for multi-chiplet and multi-socket designs.
key_facts.excerpt: The platform supports either DDR5 or LPDDR6, and features up to 256 MB of L3 cache per die... For I/O, Arm supports up to 128 lanes of PCIe 7/6 and CXL 4.0.

key_facts.fact: CSS is the semi-custom program behind Arm-based server CPUs at Azure and Google Cloud and DPUs at Nvidia and Intel; Arm has not yet named any CSS N4 partner.
key_facts.excerpt: It's the same platform we've seen at work everywhere from CPUs at Azure and Google Cloud to DPUs at Nvidia and Intel... Arm has yet to announce any partners

key_facts.fact: Arm positions CSS N4 for DPUs that offload security and networking, accelerate AI KV-caching and isolate agentic AI workloads from the host.
key_facts.excerpt: It provides the compute foundation for DPUs that offload security and networking, accelerate AI KV-caching, and isolate agentic AI workloads from the host.
